# Decisions

Every decision that shapes the project goes here, so nobody has to ask twice and no agent quietly undoes it. Newest at the bottom.

**How to write one:**

```markdown
- **Short title ({{date}}, operator decision | agent default, please confirm):** what was decided. Why. What it rules out. Supersedes: <title of an older entry, if any>.
```

- Agents: when you make a call on your own (because the docs did not say and it was not worth stopping for), log it as **agent default, please confirm**. The operator can overturn it later.
- Never delete an entry. If a decision changes, add a new one that says what it supersedes.

---
